note: Properties used in the class RDF (docs/rdf/class/<cid>.ttl|.jsonld) that the search page filters on. Wikidata properties are used as predicates as-is (wdt:). datatype iri = filter by value list (labels: rdfs:label @ja/@en in docs/rdf/all.ttl); decimal / gYear / boolean = filter by range or yes/no. inherit = when a class has no value, take it from its skos:broader class in this dataset (e.g. DBAG Class 411 -> ICE T). Values are copied from Wikidata (CC0) or entered by hand (prov:wasDerivedFrom on the class says which). on = which resource carries the value: class = the class RDF (docs/rdf/class/<cid>); livery = the livery of each 3D model (docs/rdf/model/<model-id>, path: <class> schema:subjectOf <model> . <model> tb:livery <livery> . <livery> <uri> <value>). wd = a derived facet: not one Wikidata property but a SPARQL pattern over Wikidata (?item -> ?v); lines = also the countries (P17) of the lines in tools/class_lines.tsv. operatingCountry = the countries of the operators (P137/P17) and of the lines the class runs on (P3438 on the line, P17), because P17 on a class is sometimes only the country it was built in (Bombardier Innovia Metro: Canada only). A class matches a livery facet when any of its models does. Colours are taken automatically from the face colours of each model (tools/extract_colors.py) and named with Wikidata colour items; the exact colours are on the livery as tb:colorSample (schema:color #RRGGBB, tb:areaShare).
